description: Official Python & TypeScript SDK, Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server, OpenAI/OpenRouter proxy, and Small Worlds axiom verification engine (https://synproof.ai).

Canonical documentation and AI skill instructions are located in `SKILL.md`, `AGENTS.md`, and `llms-full.txt`.
